title: pyrus pashia var. kumaoni
intro: Pyrus pashia var. kumaoni, commonly known as Kumaoni Pear, is a variety of pear tree native to the Himalayan region. It has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its potential to lower cholesterol levels, manage diabetes, and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Pyrus pashia var. kumaoni include its ability to act as an antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-cancer agent, while its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties. Furthermore, the plant's leaves and fruits are also used to treat various health conditions, such as fever, digestive issues, and skin problems.
